fruits.extendedStory: Stand back far enough and the windows do something odd. There is more glass up there than wall. That is what English Gothic reaches for, and this church has been reaching since 1220. It belongs to Saint Peter, which is why people here call it the Minster. Say cathedral and you will be gently put right.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Bauarbeiten begannen 1220. Der Stil ist englische Gotik, die die Wände hochzieht und die Lücken dazwischen mit Glas füllt. Geweiht ist die Kirche dem heiligen Petrus, weshalb man hier vom Minster spricht und nicht von der Kathedrale. Geh erst einmal außen herum. Die Größe begreift man erst, wenn man die Länge abgeschritten hat.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Stand back far enough and the windows do something odd. There is more glass up there than wall. That is what English Gothic reaches for, and this church has been reaching since 1220. It belongs to Saint Peter, which is why people here call it the Minster. Say cathedral and you will be gently put right.

localizedStory.de: 1220 begonnen und dem heiligen Petrus geweiht, in englischer Gotik mit hohen Wänden und weiten Fenstern.
localizedStory.en: Begun in 1220 and dedicated to Saint Peter, in the English Gothic manner of high walls and wide windows.

fruits.name: York Minster
fruits.story: Begun in 1220 and dedicated to Saint Peter, in the English Gothic manner of high walls and wide windows.

fruits.extendedStory: Climb the mound and you are on earth piled up in 1068. What sits on top came much later, between 1245 and 1272, paid for by Henry III and drawn by Henry de Reynes. He gave it four round lobes instead of a square, which let the men on top watch more ground at once. The site is also held in memory by York's Jews. About 150 people sheltered here in 1190 and did not come out.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Hügel stammt von 1068, der steinerne Bergfried darauf entstand zwischen 1245 und 1272 für Heinrich III. Henry de Reynes entwarf einen Grundriss aus vier runden Lappen, damit die Verteidiger von oben mehr Gelände übersahen. Der Name geht wohl auf die Familie Clifford zurück, die hier das Amt des Burgvogts beanspruchte. Dies ist auch ein Ort der Trauer. Etwa 150 Juden Yorks suchten 1190 Schutz in dem Bergfried und kamen nicht wieder heraus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Climb the mound and you are on earth piled up in 1068. What sits on top came much later, between 1245 and 1272, paid for by Henry III and drawn by Henry de Reynes. He gave it four round lobes instead of a square, which let the men on top watch more ground at once. The site is also held in memory by York's Jews. About 150 people sheltered here in 1190 and did not come out.

localizedStory.de: Ein Bergfried auf vier runden Lappen, für Heinrich III. auf einem Hügel von 1068 errichtet.
localizedStory.en: A keep standing on four round lobes, raised for Henry III on a mound thrown up in 1068.

fruits.name: Clifford's Tower
fruits.story: A keep standing on four round lobes, raised for Henry III on a mound thrown up in 1068.

fruits.extendedStory: Between 1976 and 1981 archaeologists dug the Coppergate site and found a Viking town still lying there. Timber houses, workshops, animal pens and wells came up out of the ground, along with over 40,000 objects. The centre opened in April 1984 to put that town back together where it was found. Water got into it badly in December 2015. It opened again in April 2017.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Zwischen 1976 und 1981 gruben Archäologen das Gelände Coppergate aus und fanden eine Wikingerstadt, die noch dalag. Holzhäuser, Werkstätten, Viehpferche und Brunnen kamen aus dem Boden, dazu über 40.000 Fundstücke. 1984 öffnete das Zentrum, um jene Stadt dort wieder aufzubauen, wo man sie gefunden hatte. Im Dezember 2015 drang Wasser ein. Im April 2017 öffnete es wieder.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Between 1976 and 1981 archaeologists dug the Coppergate site and found a Viking town still lying there. Timber houses, workshops, animal pens and wells came up out of the ground, along with over 40,000 objects. The centre opened in April 1984 to put that town back together where it was found. Water got into it badly in December 2015. It opened again in April 2017.

localizedStory.de: Zwischen 1976 und 1981 fand man hier eine Wikingerstadt und über 40.000 Fundstücke.
localizedStory.en: Diggers found a Viking town under this corner between 1976 and 1981, and left over 40,000 objects behind.

fruits.name: Jorvik Viking Centre
fruits.story: Diggers found a Viking town under this corner between 1976 and 1981, and left over 40,000 objects behind.

fruits.extendedStory: The lower part of this gate is twelfth century and the two storeys on top are fourteenth. From 1196 there were people living inside it, up above the archway, with the road running under their floor. It guarded the way in from the south, so anyone arriving from London came through here. That made it the gate where important arrivals were met, and it has kept that job ever since.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der untere Teil dieses Tors stammt aus dem zwölften Jahrhundert, die zwei Geschosse darüber aus dem vierzehnten. Ab 1196 wohnten Menschen darin, über dem Torbogen, mit der Straße unter dem Fußboden. Es bewachte den Weg von Süden, also kam jeder aus London hier herein. So wurde es das Tor, an dem wichtige Gäste empfangen wurden, und das ist es geblieben.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The lower part of this gate is twelfth century and the two storeys on top are fourteenth. From 1196 there were people living inside it, up above the archway, with the road running under their floor. It guarded the way in from the south, so anyone arriving from London came through here. That made it the gate where important arrivals were met, and it has kept that job ever since.

localizedStory.de: Der Weg nach York von Süden. In diesem Tor wohnen Menschen seit 1196.
localizedStory.en: The way into York from the south. People have lived inside this gate since 1196.

fruits.name: Micklegate Bar
fruits.story: The way into York from the south. People have lived inside this gate since 1196.

fruits.extendedStory: This gate goes back to the early fourteenth century. Its portcullis, the heavy grating that drops to close the arch, was still in working order as late as 1970. The rooms above have been put to odd uses over the centuries. Someone made a home up there. In the sixteenth century the same rooms held Catholics who would not fall into line.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Dieses Tor geht auf das frühe vierzehnte Jahrhundert zurück. Sein Fallgitter, das schwere Gitter, das den Bogen verschließt, war noch 1970 gangbar. Die Räume darüber dienten über die Jahrhunderte den seltsamsten Zwecken. Jemand richtete sich dort oben eine Wohnung ein. Im sechzehnten Jahrhundert saßen in denselben Räumen Katholiken, die sich nicht fügen wollten.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This gate goes back to the early fourteenth century. Its portcullis, the heavy grating that drops to close the arch, was still in working order as late as 1970. The rooms above have been put to odd uses over the centuries. Someone made a home up there. In the sixteenth century the same rooms held Catholics who would not fall into line.

localizedStory.de: Ein Tor mit einem Fallgitter, das bis 1970 noch funktionierte. Man hat darin gewohnt und darin gesessen.
localizedStory.en: A gate with a portcullis that still worked until 1970. People have lived and been locked up inside it.

fruits.name: Monk Bar
fruits.story: A gate with a portcullis that still worked until 1970. People have lived and been locked up inside it.

fruits.extendedStory: Go in and you find yourself on a street. Shopfronts, cobbles, the lot, all of it under a roof. Kirkgate is a Victorian street rebuilt indoors, and it is the reason to come. The building around it held prisoners once: debtors from 1701, and women from 1780. A doctor named John Lamplugh Kirk collected the everyday objects that fill the place.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Museum steckt in zwei Gefängnissen, dem Schuldturm von 1701 bis 1705 und dem Frauengefängnis von 1780 bis 1785. John Lamplugh Kirk war Arzt und sammelte die gewöhnlichen Dinge des Alltags. 1934 kaufte die Stadt das Frauengefängnis, um seine Sammlung unterzubringen. Drinnen liegt Kirkgate, eine viktorianische Straße mit Ladenfronten, im Inneren nachgebaut. Auch die Zelle des Wegelagerers Dick Turpin gehört dazu.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Go in and you find yourself on a street. Shopfronts, cobbles, the lot, all of it under a roof. Kirkgate is a Victorian street rebuilt indoors, and it is the reason to come. The building around it held prisoners once: debtors from 1701, and women from 1780. A doctor named John Lamplugh Kirk collected the everyday objects that fill the place.

localizedStory.de: Hier wurde eine ganze viktorianische Straße im Inneren nachgebaut, in zwei alten Gefängnissen.
localizedStory.en: A whole Victorian street was rebuilt indoors here, inside two old prisons.

fruits.name: York Castle Museum
fruits.story: A whole Victorian street was rebuilt indoors here, inside two old prisons.

fruits.extendedStory: What you walk round now is roofless stone standing in a garden. William II turned up in York in 1088, handed the monks more land, and set the house on its feet again. Money followed: by the end it was bringing in something like 2,000 pounds a year. Then in 1132 the community fell out with itself. After a riot, the monks who wanted a harder, plainer life walked out and went off to start Fountains Abbey.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Wilhelm II. kam 1088 nach York, gab den Mönchen mehr Land und gründete das Haus neu. Es wurde reich und war bei seiner Schließung etwa 2.000 Pfund im Jahr wert. 1132 brach hinter den Mauern ein Streit aus. Eine Gruppe von Mönchen, die strenger leben wollte, ging nach einem Aufruhr fort, zog nach Norden und gründete Fountains Abbey. Übrig ist heute dachloses Gemäuer in einem Garten.
localizedExtendedStory.en: What you walk round now is roofless stone standing in a garden. William II turned up in York in 1088, handed the monks more land, and set the house on its feet again. Money followed: by the end it was bringing in something like 2,000 pounds a year. Then in 1132 the community fell out with itself. After a riot, the monks who wanted a harder, plainer life walked out and went off to start Fountains Abbey.

localizedStory.de: Eine Benediktinerabtei, 1088 neu gegründet, als Wilhelm II. nach York kam und den Mönchen mehr Land gab.
localizedStory.en: Roofless stone in a garden. Benedictine monks lived here until a king closed the house down.

fruits.name: St Mary's Abbey
fruits.story: Roofless stone in a garden. Benedictine monks lived here until a king closed the house down.

fruits.extendedStory: A Roman gate stood on this spot from about the year 108, on the south-eastern side of Eboracum. Later the place turns up in tenth-century writing as Konungsgarthr, and scholars think the kings of the Danelaw kept their hall here. A church stood here too until 1937. When it came down, nineteen of its gravestones were laid as paving. Look at your feet: hardly any lettering is left to read.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Etwa ab dem Jahr 108 stand hier ein römisches Tor, an der Südostseite von Eboracum. Später hieß der Ort in Quellen des zehnten Jahrhunderts Konungsgarthr, und man vermutet hier die Halle der Könige des Danelaw. Bis 1937 stand hier außerdem eine Kirche. Als sie fiel, legte man neunzehn ihrer Grabsteine als Pflaster. Schau auf deine Füße: die Schrift ist größtenteils weg.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A Roman gate stood on this spot from about the year 108, on the south-eastern side of Eboracum. Later the place turns up in tenth-century writing as Konungsgarthr, and scholars think the kings of the Danelaw kept their hall here. A church stood here too until 1937. When it came down, nineteen of its gravestones were laid as paving. Look at your feet: hardly any lettering is left to read.

localizedStory.de: Du stehst auf einem römischen Torbau von etwa 108. Die Pflastersteine stammen aus einer Kirche.
localizedStory.en: You are standing on a Roman gateway from about the year 108. The paving stones came from a church.

fruits.name: Kings Square
fruits.story: You are standing on a Roman gateway from about the year 108. The paving stones came from a church.

fruits.extendedStory: The stone archway is twelfth century. In the fourteenth a barbican went up in front of it, a walled passage stuck out ahead of the gate. Anyone attacking had to get down it before reaching the arch. Road widening took the barbicans off York's other gates. This one still has its barbican, its portcullis and its inner doors.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der steinerne Torbogen ist aus dem zwölften Jahrhundert. Im vierzehnten kam eine Barbakane dazu, ein ummauerter Gang vor dem Tor, den Angreifer erst durchkämpfen mussten. Die hölzernen Torflügel folgten im fünfzehnten. Alle anderen Tore Yorks verloren ihre Barbakane an spätere Straßenverbreiterungen. Dieses behielt Barbakane, Fallgitter und Innentüren, obwohl es 1489 brannte und 1644 beschossen wurde.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The stone archway is twelfth century. In the fourteenth a barbican went up in front of it, a walled passage stuck out ahead of the gate. Anyone attacking had to get down it before reaching the arch. Road widening took the barbicans off York's other gates. This one still has its barbican, its portcullis and its inner doors.

localizedStory.de: Seine Barbakane steht noch, mit Fallgitter und Innentüren, wo die anderen Tore ihre verloren.
localizedStory.en: Its barbican still stands, with the portcullis and the inner doors, where the other gates lost theirs.

fruits.name: Walmgate Bar
fruits.story: Its barbican still stands, with the portcullis and the inner doors, where the other gates lost theirs.
